rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A secure HTTP request executor built with NestJS that enforces security through configurable JavaScript middleware files rather than client-side restrictions. The server uses a whitelist-based approach where no requests are allowed by default - only URLs matching configured middleware patterns can be executed. Middlewares can validate request methods, modify headers (such as adding authentication tokens), transform request bodies, and implement custom authorization logic. This architecture enables safe delegation of HTTP operations to AI assistants while maintaining granular control over which APIs can be accessed and how requests are processed, making it ideal for enterprise environments requiring secure API access with centralized policy enforcement.
